name: io.github.cyanheads/gdelt-mcp-server
description: Search and analyze global news coverage and US TV transcripts via the GDELT Project APIs.

environmentVariables.name: GDELT_CLAMP_LIMITS
environmentVariables.description: Clamp counts above each per-call cap; false rejects them.

environmentVariables.name: GDELT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the base URL for the GDELT DOC and TV APIs.

environmentVariables.name: GDELT_REQUEST_DELAY_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between GDELT requests, enforcing the 1 req/5s rate limit.

environmentVariables.name: GDELT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Deadline in milliseconds for a single GDELT request; the whole call, retries included, is bounded at twice this value.

environmentVariables.name: GDELT_MIRROR_PATH
environmentVariables.description: SQLite file of the optional local GKG mirror the DOC tools fall back to when the DOC API refuses requests. Unset leaves it off. Built with `bun run mirror:init` from a checkout or the Docker image; on Node it needs better-sqlite3 installed.

environmentVariables.name: GDELT_MIRROR_WINDOW_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days of GKG slots the local mirror keeps (1-90).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
